judge.reason: Both versions add the same send_file plugin, and they behave the same in practice. Content-type resolution gives the same result in each. A '/' type is used as is. A symbol or extension type gets a dot prefix and a Rack::Mime lookup. With no type and no extension, both fall back to application/octet-stream. Y does this in two lines; X uses nested conditionals. X adds a `|| 200` status fallback, but Rack always returns a status, so it changes nothing. X's 404 rescue goes through `response` and Y's through `res`, which are the same object.
